subject: scale_color_* is still lacking some functions compared with  scale_colour_*

messages.author: 2d475b13e63c8cd2
messages.subject: scale_color_* is still lacking some functions compared with  scale_colour_*
parts:
I'm guessing that this is known, but if not, there are not as many
functions with the American spelling as there are with the British
spelling:

> scale_color_
scale_color_brewer scale_color_gradient scale_color_gradient2
scale_color_gradientn scale_color_hue
> scale_colour_
scale_colour_brewer scale_colour_discrete
scale_colour_gradient2 scale_colour_grey
scale_colour_identity
scale_colour_continuous scale_colour_gradient
scale_colour_gradientn scale_colour_hue scale_colour_manual

Scott
